summary: additional_build_files is a list of src/dest entries copying files (absolute paths or relative globs, whole directories) into a subdirectory of _build in the build context; dest cannot be absolute or contain '..', and an ansible.cfg listed here can pass hub tokens.
questions: How do I add extra files to the ansible-builder build context?
What is additional_build_files src and dest?
How do I pass an automation hub token to ansible-builder?
Can dest in additional_build_files be absolute?
